title: The Coflex®COMMUNITY Study: An Observational Study of Coflex® Interlaminar Technology
brief_summary: The purpose of the coflexCOMMUNITY observational study is to collect information on patients with spinal stenosis undergoing back surgery with the coflex® implant, and to look at their outcomes and the cost-effectiveness of this procedure.
study_population: Cohort will be selected from clinic patients scheduled for surgery with coflex device after decompression
